scripts.build.py:
import hashlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
h = Path('/tmp/delta-reader-spark-planning/round-constant/checkout/experiments/spark-sql')
sha = lambda file: hashlib.sha256(Path(file).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
cmd = ['cargo', 'build', '--release', '--offline', '--locked', '--config', str(p / 'override.toml'), '--example', 'decimal_bench', '--example', 'decimal_probe', '--bin', 'delta-reader-sail-extraction-probe', '--message-format=json', '-j', '3']
with (p / 'cargo.jsonl').open('w') as out, (p / 'build.log').open('w') as err:
    subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=h, env=os.environ | {'CARGO_TARGET_DIR': str(p.parent / 'integer-widening-sparse-owned-542a847/target')}, stdout=out, stderr=err, check=True)
artifacts = [json.loads(line) for line in (p / 'cargo.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
artifacts = [r for r in artifacts if r.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact']
arrow = [r for r in artifacts if r['target']['name'] == 'arrow_cast']
assert len(arrow) == 1
arrow = arrow[0]
assert Path(arrow['manifest_path']).parent == p.parent / 'integer-widening-sparse-owned-542a847/arrow-cast'
binaries = {}
for name, target in [('bench', 'decimal_bench'), ('probe', 'decimal_probe'), ('runner', 'delta-reader-sail-extraction-probe')]:
    matches = [r for r in artifacts if r['target']['name'] == target and r['executable']]
    assert len(matches) == 1
    shutil.copy2(matches[0]['executable'], p / f'after-{name}')
    binaries[name] = sha(p / f'after-{name}')
record = {'command': cmd, 'binaries': binaries, 'benchmark_sha256': sha(h / 'examples/decimal_bench.rs'), 'lock_sha256': sha(h / 'Cargo.lock'), 'arrow_artifact': arrow, 'arrow_libraries': {f: sha(f) for f in arrow['filenames']}, 'arrow_mod': sha(p.parent / 'integer-widening-sparse-owned-542a847/arrow-cast/src/cast/mod.rs'), 'arrow_reuse': sha(p.parent / 'integer-widening-sparse-owned-542a847/arrow-cast/src/cast/integer_decimal_buffer.rs'), 'runtime': {key: sha(h / rel) for key, rel in json.loads((p / 'paths.json').read_text()).items()}, 'dependencies': [{'package_id': r['package_id'], 'features': r['features'], 'profile': r['profile']} for r in artifacts]}
(p / 'built.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Build complete', binaries, flush=True)
scripts.validate.py:
import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent
prior=p.parent/'integer-widening-sparse-owned-542a847'
root=Path('/home/hanbo/repo/delta-arrow-reader/experiments/spark-sql')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from decimal_division import compare
checks={}
corpora=json.loads((prior/'corpora.json').read_text())
corpora.append(['div-zero','div-zero.jsonl',str(p.parent/'div-zero-ed3602b/spark.json')])
for name,file,reference in [['new',str(p/'cases.jsonl'),str(p/'spark.json')], *corpora]:
    cases=root/file
    before=p/'before-new.json' if name=='new' else (p.parent/'div-zero-ed3602b'/('after-new.json' if name=='div-zero' else f'after-{name}.json'))
    after=p/f'after-{name}.json'
    subprocess.run([str(p/'after-probe'),str(cases),str(after),'--physical-plans'],check=True,capture_output=True)
    a=compare(Path(reference),before,cases);b=compare(Path(reference),after,cases)
    old={x['id'] for x in a['cases'] if x['differences']};new={x['id'] for x in b['cases'] if x['differences']}
    left=json.loads(before.read_text())['results'];right=json.loads(after.read_text())['results']
    checks[name]={'before_agreement':a['agreement'],'after_agreement':b['agreement'],'total':b['total'],
        'repaired':sorted(old-new),'regressed':sorted(new-old),'remaining':[x for x in b['cases'] if x['differences']],
        'changed_physical_plans':[x['id'] for x,y in zip(left,right,strict=True) if x['actual'].get('physical_plan')!=y['actual'].get('physical_plan')],
        'changed_errors':[x['id'] for x,y in zip(left,right,strict=True) if x['actual'].get('error')!=y['actual'].get('error')]}
    print(name,a['agreement'],'->',b['agreement'],'/',b['total'],'regressed:',checks[name]['regressed'],flush=True)
    (p/'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(checks,indent=2)+'\n')
assert all(not x['regressed'] for x in checks.values())

limitations: The patch is optional experimental Rust planning code. The default project build does not apply it.

The new precheck covers direct column-free integer DIV projection outputs through aliases/casts. Parent expressions and scalar-subquery planning are not covered by a general Spark constant-folding implementation.
The preceding 22 corpora retain 118 value/type/coarse-stage differences. The new 350 observations retain 48. Counts include repeated widths, shapes and ANSI settings, not independent bugs.

Four new empty scalar-subquery controls have matching error stages but the wrong error cause: Spark DIVIDE_BY_ZERO versus Arrow non-nullable output rejecting a NULL. They are unchanged from the baseline and are tracked separately from numeric comparator counts.

The five older same-stage error-cause gaps and four wrapped-sort diagnostic cases remain. Full schema metadata, exact error classes/messages and all Spark semantics are not established by numeric agreement.
Successful constant DIV still incurs a small planning cost; the measured timing ranges overlap. This is not a claim of zero overhead for all queries.
The benchmark now registers the analyzer in both variants. Older measurements using the unregistered harness cannot measure this analyzer's planning overhead.
Earlier unattributed buffer-policy timing differences around 0.4%-0.7% remain outside this before/after comparison.
